- IDE values → `ide`
- `desktop` → `desktop`
- unknown → `interactive`

tasks.name: Hook: newer-wins compares event start times; subagent events always merge
tasks.description:
The newer-wins rule compares a hook's start time with the file's `updatedAt` (the previous write time), so hooks that start close together drop each other.

- `SubagentStart`/`SubagentStop` older than `eventAt` still add or remove their subagent (the map is keyed by agent ID, so order doesn't matter) but change nothing else.

## Fix

## Tests

tasks.name: Hook: track background subagents from background_tasks
tasks.description:
A background subagent fires `SubagentStop` each time it pauses to wait on its own background work, and `SubagentStart` when it resumes, so the list drops agents Claude Code still shows as working.

## Why
`Stop` and `SubagentStop` payloads carry `background_tasks`, the parent session's in-flight task registry (hooks docs › Stop input).

## Change
Use it: entries of type `subagent` (not in a finished status) are running background subagents, keyed by `id` (= `agent_id`), marked background.
- On `Stop` the subagent list becomes exactly those (no foreground subagent runs while the main agent stops).
- On `SubagentStop`, the stopping agent stays when it is still in the list (paused), other background-marked agents missing from the list are removed, foreground ones are left alone; an older `SubagentStop` only removes or keeps its own agent.
- Without `background_tasks` the old add/remove rules apply.
- Keep each agent's first `since`.

## Docs and tests
Update `doc/state-file-schema.md`, `HookEventsTests`, a payload fixture.

- the parent's `Stop` sets it to `idle`;
- check C4 turns `waiting` into `busy` when any new child of the `claude` process starts, which other subagents do all the time.

- Record waiting per agent: e.g. `subagents[agent_id].waiting` with `reason` and `since`, or a map of pending prompts; clear it only with events of the same agent (its `PostToolUse`, its `SubagentStop`, or a denial seen in the transcript).
